features.bend-radius-front: 1/2 in (12.7 mm) at the front fingers, transitions and pass-throughs

performance.cable-capacity-basis: front channel: 0.185 in (4.70 mm, Cat 6A 28 AWG) cable at the 30% recommended fill of its 6 sq in usable area; 111 at the 50% maximum fill - Panduit Cable Capacity Calculator V14

configs.description: The manager as Panduit ships NCMHF2, cover fitted.
configs.name: base

configs.description: The same manager with its cover opened, the finger walls and the channel open to lay a cable in. The cover comes with the manager, so this is an illustration and not a device type.
configs.name: cover-off

gaps.note: the specification sheet says the hinged front cover opens 180 degrees up or down; no view draws a hinge, and the cover is drawn as one fitted plate that is either on or off.
gaps.wanted: a drawing or a close render of the cover's hinge

gaps.note: no view sections the cover or the fingers: their thickness is estimated and the elevations draw the body without the cover's edge.
gaps.wanted: a section through a cover and a finger tip
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: datasheet - the material, colour, standards and what is in the box are the NCMHF2 product page and the specification sheet (RKSP225); the screws are the drawing's note 2.

bottom.note: drawing - the front view draws the same finger arches along the bottom as along the top; the bottom is the top again.

capacity.note: datasheet - Panduit's Cable Capacity Calculator (V14) gives the NCMHF2's front usable area as 6 sq in and, for its entered cable (0.185 in, 4.70 mm, Cat 6A 28 AWG) at the 30 per cent recommended fill, 66 (111 at the 50 per cent maximum).

chassis.note: drawing - 444.83 x 88.14 x 95.1. The NCMHF2 drawing dimensions 482.59 [19.00 in] over the ears, 465.07 [18.31 in] between the fixing holes, 88.14 [3.47 in] high, 444.83 [17.51 in] across the body between the ears and 95.10 [3.74 in] deep (RKSP225 says 95.3). The ears are not drawn.

color.note: estimated - "The manager is black" on the product page. Every image Panduit publishes of the part is a render; the cover is drawn a shade lighter than the moulding.

ears.note: drawing - `positions` states where the ears bolt, for the Rack Builder. The NCMHF2 drawing (Panduit 00787-10) dimensions the plan "3.74 REF [95.10]" overall and the front section "3.24 REF [82.40]"; the NCMH2 drawing's front section is 82.27, and the two manager share one front moulding, so `at` is 82.27 as on the NCMH2 and the plate and flange are the 12.83 behind. This states a placement; the 0.13 between the two drawings is taken as drawing error.

front.note: drawing - the front with the hinged cover fitted, as the NCMH2's: the NCMHF2 drawing's front view shows the cover removed, the two rows of twelve arched fingers and the two windows.

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - the part is 95.1 deep and 82.27 of it stands in front of the rails, so the rear face of its rack units stays free for another part.

guides.note: drawing - the duct is the channel between the two finger rows, run across the rack, pitch 34.925 and gap 9.5 as on the NCMH2.

left.note: estimated - no side view is drawn; built from the plan view and the front view.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S OWN DRAWING, read as the NCMH2's are (see ncmh2): the NCMHF2 customer drawing (PDF 00787-10), the NetManager Horizontal Cable Managers specification sheet RKSP225 and the Cable Capacity Calculator. The parts are the NCMH2's front moulding.

rear.note: drawing - the back of the plate with its two windows, from the front view, which draws them through the channel; five plates round them, sunk 0.05 inside the rear face. The windows are open.

right.note: estimated - the left view turned round.

shell.note: drawing - A HOLLOW CHANNEL, NOT A BOX (see ncmh2): the plate on the front view as a well 82.27 deep with two open windows, the two walls of fingers standing in it, the cover across their tips and the back of the plate standing 12.83 proud of the rear face.

thickness.note: estimated - no Panduit document states a wall gauge for the polycarbonate moulding. 2.5 is a moulded wall of this size; the parts carry their own thicknesses.

top.note: drawing - the plan view, rear at y=0: the plate and flange 12.83 deep, then the twelve fingers 70 mm long. Read at 300 dpi; the fingers' lengths are estimated.

weight.note: drawing - 381.02 g [0.84 lb], the weight table of the NCMHF2 customer drawing (00787-10).
